prompt_text: How to set up tribute and memorial giving
response_text:
# Setting Up Tribute and Memorial Giving

## 1. **Establish the Program Framework**

### Define Your Approach
- **In Honor vs. In Memory**: Clarify both options
- **Dedication opportunities**: Specific projects, general fund, or both
- **Minimum amounts**: If any (though most programs accept gifts of any size)
- **Recognition policies**: What will be shared publicly vs. privately

## 2. **Create Notification Systems**

### For Honorees/Families
- **Notification cards**: Send to family/honoree announcing the gift (without amount)
- **Timing**: Send promptly (within 1-2 weeks)
- **Content**: Donor name (unless anonymous), tribute message, your organization's mission

### For Donors
- **Acknowledgment letters**: Include tax receipt and thank you
- **Confirmation**: That notification was sent to appropriate party

## 3. **Set Up Online Giving**

### Website Features
- Dedicated tribute giving page
- Checkbox on regular donation forms
- Fields for:
  - Type of tribute (honor/memory)
  - Honoree name
  - Notification recipient name and address
  - Personal message option
  - E-card selection (optional)

## 4. **Develop Marketing Materials**

### Promotional Items
- **Brochure/insert** for funeral homes
- **Language for obituaries**: Suggested wording families can use
- **Email templates** for staff
- **Social media graphics**
- **Sample will language** for planned gifts

### Key Messaging
- "Honor a loved one's legacy"
- "Celebrate a special occasion"
- "Make a gift that makes a difference in their name"

## 5. **Create Physical Materials**

- **Memorial envelopes**: Special remittance envelopes for funeral homes
- **Tribute cards**: Pre-printed cards donors can send
- **Bookplates/plaques**: For larger gifts (if appropriate)
- **Memorial book/wall**: Physical or virtual recognition space

## 6. **Build Partnerships**

### Funeral Homes
- Provide them with your materials
- Make it easy for families to designate your organization
- Establish contact person and procedures

### Event Planners
- For celebration gifts (birthdays, anniversaries, retirements)

## 7. **Internal Processes**

### Database Setup
- **Fields to track**:
  - Tribute type
  - Honoree name
  - Relationship to donor
  - Notification recipient contact info
  - Date notification sent
  - Any restrictions on the gift

### Staff Training
- Who processes these gifts
- Timeline expectations
- Sensitive communication protocols
- How to handle special requests

## 8. **Recognition Options**

Consider offering:
- **Giving levels** with different recognition
- **Annual memorial/honor roll** in newsletter or website
- **Memorial garden/brick program**
- **Named funds** for significant gifts
- **Virtual memorial pages** on your website

## 9. **Tax Considerations**

- Memorial gifts are **tax-deductible** (follow standard rules)
- Ensure receipts go to actual donor, not honoree
- If donor receives goods/services (memorial dinner, etc.), adjust deductible amount

## 10. **Sensitive Communication Guidelines**

### Best Practices
- Use compassionate, respectful language
- Proofread names carefully
- Don't pressure grieving families
- Honor privacy requests
- Be flexible with timing
- Train staff in empathetic communication

### Avoid
- Soliciting too soon after a death
- Being transactional in tone
- Sharing gift amounts with families
- Pushy follow-up

## 11. **Measurement & Reporting**

Track:
- Number of tribute gifts
- Revenue from program
- Conversion rate from materials distributed
- Donor retention from tribute givers
- Average gift size

## Sample Notification Card Wording

> *Dear [Family Name],*
>
> *We want you to know that a gift has been made to [Organization] in loving memory of [Name] by [Donor Name]. This thoughtful tribute will help [specific impact].*
>
> *Please accept our heartfelt condolences. [Name]'s memory will live on through this generous gift.*
>
> *With sympathy,*
> *[Your Organization]*

## Quick Start Checklist

- [ ] Add tribute option to donation page
- [ ] Create notification card template
- [ ] Set up database fields
- [ ] Draft acknowledgment letter templates
- [ ] Create funeral home partnership materials
- [ ] Train staff on procedures
- [ ] Add tribute giving to website menu
- [ ] Develop marketing materials

This program can become a significant, sustainable revenue stream while providing meaningful ways for donors to honor loved ones.
